name: Arne Alternata
original_name: アルネ・アルタナータ
source:
The auxiliary bishop of the Magic Department, and the next lead of the powerful family of mages, the House of Alternata. Arne is formal, serious and family-oriented, and is often found in the training grounds of her department.

She got into an arranged marriage with [url=https://vndb.org/c103282]Belial[/url], which she's content with as it should allow her family to prosper further. She's the older sister of [url=https://vndb.org/c103286]Enoch[/url], and the niece of [url=https://vndb.org/c103287]Erzsebet[/url].
